$comment: Per-repo values read by the sydevs `workflow` plugin and its skills. Values only — the rules that consume them live in the skills, the stories in docs/why.md. This repo is unusual: it holds the plugin itself, so a change here changes how every other repo is worked on.

leanGate.contents: Plugin manifest + skill frontmatter validation, then the workflow/lib unit tests — the scripts that own mechanical rules (budgets, the dispatch payload, base refs). The skills are prose, and their real gate is a supervised loop run.

securityReview.rationale: Hooks run in a maintainer's session with their credentials. Every .md under a skill directory, nested ones included, is an instruction to an agent holding write access to five repos. workflow/lib scripts handle tokens, and the dispatcher and its workflows act in every repo.

deployTarget: Consumed live from `main` by the Claude routines on their next run. An installed plugin (`/plugin install workflow@sydevs`) is pinned to the commit it installed, and moves only when `version` in workflow/.claude-plugin/plugin.json changes. There is no release step: merging to main IS the deploy.
